tool_args.rationale: Seven observations span low, nominal, and near-critical s_grad values; the two added wide-leverage rows address the pilot collinearity. Fit the three-parameter square-root local-branch siphon numerically with the mandated wide fallback bounds, avoiding an unnecessary further probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The acquired probe already added substantial s_grad leverage (0.18 and 2.35), resolving the stated narrow-span identifiability issue.
The observed maximum s_grad is 2.35, below the supplied 2.36 threshold for acquiring the high-s_grad probe; there is no observed supercritical regime.
The observations increase monotonically with u_now in the sampled range, unlike the provided Haldane candidate's high-u decline; the base-field and sink-gradient signatures favor the siphon family.
